description: Changes the team of an app (appId) or of a project (projectId: every app in it, now and future). Owner only. add invites by email or friend id into groups: on an app it waits for neblla_promote "save" (the email goes out then), on a project it is immediate; an address with no Neblla account waits until they sign up. add with owner: true offers them ownership of the app (on accept it is theirs). remove is immediate. group_save / group_delete: a group's rights per panel area. Ready-made groups: partner (all but money), support, viewer (read only), screens (custom screens only), staff (own Business). Testers of pre: neblla_pre_access. More: neblla_get_llms tools/team

access.description: add: one ready-made group (older form of groups).

action.description: What to do. By action: add {email | friend, groups?: [ids], access?, panels?: [names] | "*", role?, expiresInDays?}; resend {email, expiresInDays?}; remove {email}; group_save {id?, name, rights, own?, sites?, panels?, members?: [emails]}; group_delete {id}

email.description: add / resend / remove: the person's email.

expiresInDays.description: add / resend: days to accept the invitation (1-30, default 7).

friend.description: add: a Neblla friend's id (neblla_team_read "friends"), instead of email.

groups.description: add: the groups they are in (ids or ready-made names).

members.description: group_save: exactly who is in it (emails or keys).

own.description: group_save: limits Business to the member's own sessions and data.

owner.description: add: true offers them ownership of the app; false withdraws the offer.

panels.description: add / group_save: custom back-office screens by name, or "*".

projectId.description: The project whose team it is, instead of appId.

rights.description: group_save: { area: "read" | "write" }; areas: home, stats, people, business, moderation, team, testers, panels, features, money, build, publish, settings.

role.description: add: the role shown for them in the team list.

sites.description: group_save: the sites its Business is limited to; null: all.

name: neblla_team
title: Manage the team
